Level 1: Bias Model.Description: Baseline model estimating general ingroup favoritism (gamma) and lapse rate (w).

Level 2: Symmetric Model.Description: Traditional self-anchoring with a single projection rate (alpha) where ingroup assimilation equals outgroup repulsion.

Level 3: Symmetric + Lambda.Description: Adds Shepard's Law (lambda) to the symmetric model to estimate the semantic radius of generalization.

Level 4: Asymmetric + Lambda.Description: The full architecture decoupling alpha_in (ingroup love) from alpha_out (outgroup hate) with the lambda gradient.
